definitions.short: properly, a circlet , i.e. a diadem
definitions.full: H3804. kether כֶּ֫תֶר noun masculine crown ((perhaps Persian loan-word Lag Ges Abh. 207 ); Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic כִּתְרָא ; Arabic the higher hump of a camel); — always construct, in combin ׳כ מַלְכוּת royal crown Est 1:11 ; 2:17 (both of queen), 6:8 (of king).
